name: Agentic Trust Foundation
mission: Trust, Delegation & Access Layer for the Agentic Internet
problem: Establishing trustworthy delegated action between AI agents, users, services and systems
canonical_description: ATF defines the trust, identity, delegation, authorization and accountability layer for agents acting on behalf of users and organizations.

components.agentic-trust: Core trust, identity, delegation, authorization and accountability layer
components.agent-pay: Financial control and payment execution layer built on ATF authority

principle: ATF establishes authority; downstream systems execute within that authority.
evidence_rule: Implementation and CI evidence must not be presented as independent production, adoption, or certification evidence.
